Name: Everyday Warps for Practical Magical Folk
Author: thesameplant
Description:
[size=5][b]✨ Adds 3 new obelisk buildings, purchasable in the Wizard's house.﻿ ✨ 
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]A shimmering transparent cloud.[/b] Place it in front of any feature or furniture to turn it into an obelisk that warps you directly to the Wizard's house! (Even outside of his normal hours!)[/size]
[*][size=4][b]A minecart of your very own! [/b]Which warps you to the minecart at the bus stop. Because it is sooooo far to walk.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]A railroad crossing sign [/b]that will zap you straight to the railroad station.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]And BONUS[/b] craftable minecart track flooring so that you can build out your own track! [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]In game use:
[/size][size=4][b]You can purchase the obelisks from the Wizard. 
[/b][/size][size=3]There are no prerequisites to purchasing these. Just pay the man.[/size]

[color=#f1f1f1][size=3]You can configure any of the obelisks to be either enabled or disabled. If you disable them, they will not show in the shop, AND they will not work if you have already built them. Though if you re-enable them existing ones will work again. The reason they're configurable is in case you don't want to clutter up Rasmodius' shop. [u]The Sparkle Obelisk comes in three different sizes and all of them have the same function.[/u] If you only want one, you don't need to see them all in the store.

[/size][/color][size=4]TO RECONFIGURE, y[/size][size=4]ou can either:[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If you have the ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ mod installed, it can be edited there, and they will become immediately available (or unavailable), no need to restart your game.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Manually edit the config.json file. (It will show up once you have started the game once. It will not be there when you initially download the mod.) If you do this while your game is running, you will need to either restart your game, or use the following command in your terminal.[/size]
[/list][code]patch reload "TheSamePlant.EverydayWarps"
[/code]
[size=3]They have magical construction, so they are built immediately, and work just the same as ordinary obelisks.[/size]



[color=#f1f1f1][size=6]﻿💬[/size][size=5] If you have any ideas for new locations I'd love to hear from you![/size]
[size=4]I'll consider all requests, except the summit. Just trust me... you don't want to warp there.

[/size][/color]💬 [size=5]If you have a request for language support, let me know. I'm happy to add any translations.
[/size][color=#f1f1f1][size=4][b]Do not[/b] repost this mod with a translation file.[/size]


[size=3][b]** Big thanks to rokugin, chu/e and Button on the discord for the assist with the flooring!! <3[/b]
[/size]
[/color][size=3]Other Mods visible in the pictures:
[/size]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22954]Nano's Decorative Tree Furniture[/url] - the unusual bush in the first cover image.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url] (with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20698]temporary fix[/url])
